helpers.clamp: const clamp = (x, a, b) => (x < a ? a : x > b ? b : x);
helpers.lerp: const lerp = (a, b, t) => a + (b - a) * t;
helpers.sstep: const sstep = (e0, e1, x) => { const t = clamp((x - e0) / (e1 - e0), 0, 1); return t * t * (3 - 2 * t); };
helpers.angDiff: const angDiff = (a, b) => { let d = (b - a) % TAU; if (d > Math.PI) d -= TAU; else if (d < -Math.PI) d += TAU; return d; };
